questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, You have to decide which conclusions logically follows from the given statements.

**Statements:**

All dogs are cats.

Some cats are hens.

All hens are pink.

**Conclusion I:** Some dogs are cats.

**Conclusion II:** Some cats are pink.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/581159284d504b5cf44db6335b00f5b1cff6d29dbca29d5758c25e7741779ca1.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some dogs are cats → **F**ollow (As all dogs are cats So, as whole dogs comes in cats therefore it is definitely true)

II. Some cats are pink → Follow (As some cats are hens and all hens are pink. So, as some part of cats is common with hens which whole comes in pink therefore it is definitely true)

∴ Here, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (2)".

Shagun sits 2nd to the left of Pragya. Yati sits 2nd to the left of Shagun. Lovey sits 3rd to the left of Yati. Savi sits 2nd to the left of Lovey.

Who sits 3rd to the left of Shagun?
questions.solution:

questions.question: If 15th Feb 2010 is Monday. then what will be the day of the week on 7th July 2011?
questions.solution:
Given : 15th Feb 2010 was Monday

Explanation :

The number of odd days from 15th Feb 2010 to 7th July 2011 :

 
 

 Year
 Period
 Calculation
 Odd days
 
 

 2010
 15 Feb 2010 - 31 December 2010
 365 days - 31 January - 15 February = 319 days
 319 ÷ 7 = 4
 
 

 2011
 1st January 2011 - 7th July 2011
 31 January + 28 February + 31 March + 30 April + 31 May + 30 June + 7 July = 188 days
 188 ÷ 7 = 6
 
 

 Total odd days
 (10 ÷ 7) = 3
 
 

∴ The number of odd days from 15th Feb 2010 to 7th July 2011 ⇒ 3

⇒So, Three odd day get added to Monday because day asked in future.

∴ Thursday was the day of the week on the 7th July 2011.

Hence, "**Thursday**" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
What will come in the place of '?' in the following equation, if '+' and ‘-' are interchanged and '×' and ‘÷' are interchanged?

216 × 36 - 6 ÷ 17 + 39 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

Given equation : 216 × 36 - 6 ÷ 17 + 39 = ?

Now if '+' and ‘-' are interchanged and '×' and ‘÷' are interchanged then:

⇒ __**216 ÷ 36**__ + 6 × 17 - 39 = ?

⇒ 6 + __**6 × 17**__ - 39 = ?

⇒ __**6 + 102**__ - 39 = ?

⇒ __**108 - 39**__ = 69.

Hence, the correct answer is *'Option 1'.*
